name: Tiketa
summary: A cinema booking service on its own site: a seat map, with a LangGraph chat agent and an MCP server as add-ons. A demo: every ticket is free.
caption: Cinema booking with a chat agent and MCP as add-ons

name: Dispatch
summary: Makes very fast, accurate decisions from messy text or images into custom prompt-defined choices, with calibrated probabilities.
caption: Configurable System 1 decision router

name: Lens
summary: Finds pictures from English or Indonesian text or an image, plus custom picture indexing in Typesense.
caption: Multimodal vector search in Typesense

name: Gatekeeper
summary: Bilingual (EN/ID) LLM security gateway: blocks prompt injection, out-of-topic requests, and malicious tool results.
caption: LLM security gateway

name: Ledger
summary: Reads supplier invoices with a vision model, verifies every sum in code, matches bank debits.
caption: Invoice extraction and bank reconciliation

name: Footfall
summary: Counts people crossing a camera line and times how long they wait, with every head blurred.
caption: Camera line counting and dwell timing
